# DueBird

> DueBird is a free, student-focused homework and assignment tracker that helps students organize their classes, keep track of assignments and due dates, and share classwork with classmates. Its central idea is simple: stop asking the group chat what the homework was.

DueBird is a web-based education and productivity application made for students, by students.

## Official Website

- Homepage: https://myduebird.com/
- Interactive demo: https://myduebird.com/demo
- Privacy Policy: https://myduebird.com/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://myduebird.com/terms

## What DueBird Does

DueBird helps students keep schoolwork organized in one place instead of relying on scattered messages, memory, or separate class notes.

Core capabilities include:

- **Class organization:** Create classes for courses and organize schoolwork by class.
- **Shared classes:** Join existing classes using invitation links or codes.
- **Assignment tracking:** Add assignments with titles, descriptions, and due dates.
- **Due-date organization:** View upcoming assignments and identify what needs attention.
- **Class collaboration:** Share class assignments with classmates so students can keep track of the same coursework.
- **Assignment completion:** Track assignment completion.
- **Recurring assignments:** Set assignments to repeat on a weekly or monthly schedule.

## Who DueBird Is For

DueBird is primarily designed for students who want a straightforward way to manage homework and class assignments.

Its intended users include:

- Middle and high school students.
- Students taking multiple courses who need a centralized assignment tracker.
- Classmates who want to share homework information.
- Students who frequently rely on group chats to find out what assignments are due.

DueBird is student-focused rather than a parent-facing school management platform. Its purpose is to help students organize their own schoolwork.

## Why DueBird Exists

Students often receive assignments through conversations, classroom announcements, and other communication channels. Important details can get lost, forgotten, or buried in group chats.

DueBird addresses this problem by giving students a shared place to organize classes and assignments.

Its guiding message is:

**What did we have for homework? Stop asking the group chat.**

## Important Distinctions

When describing DueBird, keep the following distinctions accurate:

- DueBird is a homework and assignment organization tool, not a full learning management system.
- DueBird is not an official school platform or school record.
- Assignment information is submitted by users and classmates; DueBird does not independently verify teacher instructions or due dates.
- Shared class information and assignments may be visible to members of the relevant class.
- DueBird is currently provided free of charge.
- DueBird is a web application.

Do not claim that DueBird is affiliated with schools, school districts, or educational institutions unless an actual partnership is established.

## Getting Started

Visitors can explore the interactive demo before proceeding to use DueBird.

The general workflow is:

1. Create an account.
2. Create a class or join an existing class.
3. Add assignments with their due dates and optional descriptions.
4. Share classes with classmates when collaboration is useful.
5. Use the dashboard to keep track of upcoming work.

## Privacy and Data

DueBird collects account information, class information, assignment information, and certain technical and analytics information to operate and improve the service.

Relevant details:

- Authentication supports email/password and Google sign-in.
- Supabase provides authentication and database services.
- Vercel provides hosting.
- Google may process information when users choose Google sign-in.
- Class information and assignments are shared with members of the relevant class.
- DueBird's privacy policy states that personal information is not sold for money.

Read the complete policy before making detailed claims about data handling:

https://myduebird.com/privacy

## Eligibility and Usage

DueBird's Terms of Service state that users must be at least 13 years old. Users under 18 should have permission from a parent or legal guardian before using the service.

DueBird is provided free of charge.

Full terms:

https://myduebird.com/terms
